summary: Eldorado Gold filed a Form 6-K furnishing a September 8, 2026 news release announcing first copper-gold concentrate production at its wholly owned Skouries Project in northern Greece, a construction-to-operations milestone. First concentrate was produced September 8 during plant commissioning and ramp-up, with commercial production expected in Q4 2026. Ore stockpile exceeds 4.6 million tonnes above reserve grade, supporting over seven months of throughput. Skouries is expected to average 140,000 ounces gold and 67 million pounds copper annually. No deal terms, securities, or transactional event are disclosed, so this is not a special situation.
